windowTitle: Serial integration stage 8 - the Instance install manifest gap for the new domain owners
scope: Read-only inspection of the Instance repository to name the exact deployment gap for the new default-App/Agent delivery chain. No Instance content changed; the Instance checkout is dirty and its default branch is main on the remote.

findings.fact: gaofeng21cn/opl-instance-medopl deploy/tke/opl-cloud.k8s.json (Instance main, via origin/main) deploys exactly opl-cloud-control-plane, opl-cloud-ledger, opl-cloud-fabric. It contains no Deployment, Service or ADDR env for Serve, Workspace, Capability, Build, Runtime Control, CloudIdentity/tenant, Gateway Integration or Resource Catalog, and instance/medopl.json still records productSha a59bde68 with release tag v0.1.7.
findings.consequence: The installed product is the legacy Control Plane topology. The default-OPL-App and built-Agent chains cannot be delivered on it without an install-manifest change that deploys the new domain owners.

findings.fact: The install change for the Agent build-chain owners is Instance PR #348 ('Deploy the Cloud Agent build chain owners on medopl', branch codex/deploy-agent-build-chain), which is CLOSED (not merged) as of 2026-09-29. That branch's manifest adds opl-cloud-capability, opl-cloud-build, opl-cloud-runtime-control, opl-cloud-tenant, opl-cloud-console-bff and opl-cloud-buildkit, but still not Serve or Workspace.
findings.consequence: Even the closed proposal would not install Serve/Workspace, so the default-App delivery owner would still be absent. The instance install path must be extended beyond #348 before any Stage-8 acceptance.

findings.fact: deploy.yml admits only on ref main with environment production, and preflight/qualification-decision also require ref main and environment production; the local Instance checkout is a dirty feature branch and must not be reset.
findings.consequence: Stage 8 is gated on the Instance repository's protected main plus its production environment, and on a Candidate whose product SHA matches the deployed Cloud image.

notRun: Any Instance change, Candidate build, deployment, provider action or production readback.
claimBoundary: This receipt records the exact Instance install-manifest gap that blocks Stage 8. It claims no Instance change, no deployment and no production acceptance.
